title: GAP Waiver Plus 150 Exclusions: Vehicle Service Contract Refund
content:
**GAP Waiver Addenda, GAP Waiver Plus 150 excluded total: the add-on part.** For the Plus excluded total, the refund of the service contract enters as the add-on part. The service contract is the Vehicle Service Contracts holding financed on the same contract.

| Service contract | Add-on part |
|---|---|
| cancelled for the total loss | its refund under its own terms (as figured below) |
| cancelled for another reason, effective before the date of loss | 0.00 |
| any other case | the service contract's refund does not change the add-on part, which remains its day-prorated price for the days after the date of loss |

**The refund under its own terms.** This is the refund issued. While none has been issued, it is the price times one less the larger of two shares, with that larger share never above one:

- the share of its term in days used to the cancellation effective date;
- the share of its term in miles used to the cancellation odometer.

That figure is rounded half-up to the cent, less the claims it paid (authorized amounts less deductibles) and less its cancellation fee. The result is never below 0.00, and it is 0.00 when it is below its minimum refund.

*Hypothetical case.* A service contract cancelled for the total loss has already issued a refund of 410.00. The add-on part is 410.00, whatever its own formula would give.
